module.purpose: Internal module providing low-level building blocks for atom state management, including dependency tracking, mounting/unmounting lifecycle, store creation, and callback handling. Marked as subject to change without notice.
module.summary: This file implements the core reactive atom system internals. It defines the state structures (AtomState, Mounted), building block functions for reading/writing atoms, managing dependencies, handling mount/unmount lifecycle, and implementing store hooks. The module exports internal types and functions prefixed with INTERNAL_ for use by the library's internals, along with utility functions for debugging and development.
module.businessContext: Provides foundational reactive state management capabilities. If this fails, the entire atom-based reactivity system breaks, causing apps using the library to have broken state updates, memory leaks, or incorrect dependency tracking.

notifyInBatch callback is null/undefined — subscriptions still establish; batch notification is skipped
Atom already subscribed by another hook — independent subscription lifecycle; unmounting one does not affect the other

units.name: buildStore

detail.name: buildStore
preconditions: buildingBlocks must contain the required building block functions (ensureAtomState, readAtomState, mountAtom, writeAtomState, recomputeInvalidatedAtoms, flushCallbacks, etc.)
store must be a valid store instance with a mountedMap
atom must be a valid atom descriptor
postconditions: After execution, the atom has an entry in mountedMap if it did not already
All atoms in atomState.d (direct dependencies) are mounted before the atom itself
If the atom is writable and has onMount, the onMount callback is invoked with a functional setAtom setter
The mount record contains l (listeners), d (dependencies), and t (reverse-dependents) sets
invariants: Dependencies are always mounted before the atom itself (topological order)
Each mounted atom's mount record t-set (reverse dependents) includes the atoms that depend on it
The mountedMap is the source of truth for whether an atom is already mounted — no double-mount occurs
edgeCases: If atom is already present in mountedMap, the mount logic is skipped entirely (idempotent mount)
If atom is read-only (not actually writable), onMount is never invoked even if it has one defined
setAtom provided to onMount: if called synchronously within onMount, recompute and flush are skipped until after onMount returns (isSync flag gates deferred recompute/flush)
If atom has no dependencies (atomState.d is empty), the dependency mount loop is a no-op and only self-mount occurs
stateMutations: mountedMap (store global): a new entry is set for the atom if not already present
Each dependency's mount record t-set: the atom is added as a reverse-dependent
The atom's mount record d-set is initialized from atomState.d keys
detail.summary: Orchestrates the full mount of an atom into the store: ensures atom state exists, reads/computes atom state if not yet mounted, mounts all dependencies before the atom itself, creates a mount record with listeners/dependencies/reverse-dependents sets, and invokes the atom's onMount lifecycle if applicable. Provides a setAtom closure to onMount that handles synchronous writes and deferred recompute/flush on async writes.
